projects.name: Forge
projects.summary: A Figma-based design system I independently created, bringing together reusable UI components, design foundations and accessibility considerations to support consistent digital experiences.
details: Buttons, cards, alerts, tabs, accordions, badges, toggles and more.
Colour, typography, spacing and consistent visual rules.
Focus states, contrast and inclusive interaction considerations.
Guidance for using components consistently across designs.
projects.story: My curiosity about design systems led me to build Forge in Figma to better understand their purpose and how they work. Through this hands-on exploration, I learned that a design system is more than a collection of components. It creates a shared language between design and development, brings consistency to digital experiences and makes complex interfaces easier to build and evolve.
